title: Borel gluing of chart fields over disjoint injective images (Lusin–Souslin; parent Step 9)
statement:
Let m, P ∈ ℕ, and for each j ∈ ℕ let Y_j ⊆ ℝ^m be Borel and ψ_j, Φ_j : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, with ψ_j continuous and injective on Y_j and Φ_j continuous on Y_j. Assume the sets ψ_j(Y_j) are pairwise disjoint.

Then there is a Borel measurable g : ℝ^P → ℝ^P such that:
- g(ψ_j(y)) = Φ_j(y) for every j and every y ∈ Y_j;
- g(x) = 0 for every x ∉ ⋃_j ψ_j(Y_j).
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (ψ Φ : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid P), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y j) ∧ ContinuousOn (ψ j) (Y j) ∧ InjOn (ψ j) (Y j) ∧ ContinuousOn (Φ j) (Y j)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, Measurable g ∧ (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, g (ψ j y) = Φ j y) ∧ ∀ x, (∀ j, x ∉ ψ j '' Y j) → g x = 0
